scope: Exploratory paired replay of archived production acceptance, not a held-out reliability benchmark
arms: assertion guidance, criterion evidence reasons, complete small test-file readback
order: Alternate baseline and candidate for each production repeat, then candidate controls once each
success: Candidate must refuse production for a relevant missing assertion or actual contract violation, not an unrelated finding; controls must distinguish missing proof from actual defects without demanding a framework
limits: Same-day tool-free local subscription replay; small adaptive development sample. No tool execution, artifact mutation, production run or proof credit. Baseline and candidate include the same historical observations except the complete small test-file excerpt.
